responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines H8/300 test, compare, bit-test, and condition-value store patterns. It models how registers, masked subparts, and bit extracts set the custom CC modes, provides cmp/tst patterns for QI/HI/SI operands, supplies peepholes that preserve compare information across loads or memory tests, and includes cstore/store-flag sequences that materialize selected condition-code results into registers, making it the primary condition-code production and consumption companion to jumpcall.md.
